title: Hand-cranked Crusher
pages: Build a crusher with six cobblestone or other stone tool materials, two iron ingots and a piston. Crafting rows: stone/stone/stone; iron/piston/iron; stone/stone/stone. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better. Craft this guide from a book and cobblestone (shapeless).

Right-click to open the crusher. Place ingredients in the left slot and collect products from the right slot. Shift-click transfers stacks between the machine and your inventory; you can also recover unused input. Press Crank to supply 80 FE, or shift-right-click the block with an empty hand. The menu shows stored FE, progress in ticks and the operating state. All changes run on the server.

The crusher uses 4 FE per tick. Plants take 40 ticks; ore processing takes 140-160 ticks. Feed raw iron, copper or gold to obtain two grit; smelt or blast each grit into one ingot. Other operations include stone to cobblestone, cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand, mineral block recovery, flowers to double dye, glass recycling and one terracotta block back to four clay balls. Ashing one terracotta block costs four clay balls. Prismarine bricks crush back to four shards, the same as one prismarine block, so brick conversion never multiplies shards. A brief two-impact gear sound marks each completed batch when the output enters the right slot.

Automation: by default the top and horizontal faces accept inputs, and the bottom allows output extraction. Six menu buttons cycle each world face through Off, In and Out. Off blocks item transfer, In accepts ingredients, Out exposes only finished products. Changes apply immediately to connected hoppers and Forge item handlers, and persist with the machine. All faces still accept Forge energy (16,000 FE capacity); energy cannot be extracted. A blocked output pauses work and energy use. Breaking the machine drops its inventory and loses buffered energy.

Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes. Type: arcana_industry:crushing. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), result (item/count), duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID. Override an existing recipe at its exact ID. Reload resets work if its definition changes. The mod never removes another mod's recipes.

With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip above Crank to browse Crushing recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The category lists ingredient alternatives and quantities, output, duration in ticks, energy per tick and total energy, power sources and required output space. The crusher is the category catalyst. Higher recipe priority wins; ties use ascending recipe ID. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
